text:
Does Google work for a niche service? Test and tag, asbestos testing, pest inspections.

Nobody searches those for fun. They search the day they need one. Tags expired. Audit Monday. Reno starting in a 1960s house in Moorooka.

Small numbers. Every one ready to book. Be on the map when they look.

"Do I need a Google profile if people can find my website?"

An Adelaide electrician asked me that. Then admitted the website was ordinary.

His business wasn't on the map. His site sat on page two.

The profile is free. Claim it and fill in every field. Website second.

I respect the grind. But four months polishing a marketing plan with nothing live is planning to plan.

Pick one thing. Get it running this week. Fix it as the calls come in.

Young George would have built a 30-slide strategy deck first.

He'd still be on slide nine.
